description: A team's first season playing home games in a brand-new stadium building (not a renaming, not a renovation of the same bowl). Sourced from Wikipedia's chronology of NFL stadiums and ESPN's new-stadium-debuts retrospective, September 2026.

instances.notes: Also the franchise's first-ever season (2002 expansion team) — no prior-team baseline, confounded with a rookie roster.
Shared venue/season with NYG — same confounds.
COVID-19 season — games played with no fans in attendance, a major confound for any 'new building energy' theory.
